icy-body-rock-fraction.icy-intact: the width and limits of the rock fraction are not sourced; the centre is [R0390]
icy-body-rock-fraction.icy-stripped: a dwarf planet whose ice a collision removed [R0269]; the share of such bodies is not measured

moon-origin.disk: regular moon of a circumplanetary disk; the odds of each origin share the probability equally until a population study gives them
moon-origin.impact: giant-impact moon; the odds are shared equally until a population study gives them
moon-origin.captured: captured body; the odds are shared equally until a population study gives them
moon-origin.ring: ring-born moon; the odds are shared equally until a population study gives them
moon-origin.binary: partner of a dwarf planet; the odds are shared equally until a population study gives them

giant-compact-core.compact core: formation models predict one [R1895]; gravity cannot see one under about 10 Earth masses, so the share is a placeholder
giant-compact-core.no compact core: convective mixing or a giant impact removed it, or it never formed [R1895]; the share is a placeholder

atmosphere-d.note: row d7 is the only row for these classes and is a gate-only flag (primary H/He kept or not): 0 means it is not kept

atmosphere-j.note: the frost-equilibrium rows (j3, j4) are temperature windows: outside the window no such atmosphere is drawn

atmosphere-n.note: the rows are independent presence flags for clouds, haze and dust, not exclusive odds: none of them holding is an air without aerosol

unreached_allowed.atmosphere-e/e1/I: GEN.903 (low priority, owner Aux 1, rides the class cut-over): group b has only row b4 for class I, so p('b4') is 1 and (1 - p('b4')) is 0: the table never gives an I planet bare rock or the retained H/He envelope. The generator draws an I planet's air from the giant mixture (H2 and He), so these rows are not on its path; whether the gate or the weight changes is for the table's owner
unreached_allowed.atmosphere-e/e2/I: GEN.903 (low priority, owner Aux 1, rides the class cut-over): same as e1/I: the retained-envelope row, and the envelope-metal rows e5 and e6 that follow it, are never reached for class I
unreached_allowed.atmosphere-e/e3/T: group b has no row for class T, so p('b4') is 0: the table never makes a gas giant a water world; probably intended
unreached_allowed.atmosphere-e/e4/T: same as e3/T: no hycean gas giant
